result.title: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
result.summary: Rapid advances in cowork agents are shifting human-AI collaboration toward real-world automation, delivering software, designs, and other artifacts. However, such productivity work demands both high-quality delivery on complex productivity tasks and continued monitoring and decision-making over long horizons, a combination that remains an open challenge. We introduce CoworkOS, a general-purpose harness for long-horizon work that separates task strategy from execution management: the model decides actions, delegation, and acceptance, while the runtime maintains state and feedback. Its three-layer architecture enables direct execution or delegation to Subagents, synchronously or asynchronously, under stable responsibilities. Through a shared application layer, humans and agents inspect and revise the same evolving documents, presentations, CAD models, and Blender scenes, so human-in-the-loop participation can enter both through conversation and through direct modification of the work itself. To sustain continuity across agents and sessions, CoworkOS further introduces hierarchical workspaces and persistent semantic memory, so working files, key decisions, and long-running Job logs remain shareable, reusable, and resumable after interruption. Across 12 benchmarks and 6 categories of real-world applications, CoworkOS proves highly competitive with frontier agent applications such as Codex and DeepSeek Harness. As a sustained-work case study, CoworkOS uses GLM-5.3 as its backbone to conduct RSI-driven automated post-training on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Over five rounds, the model's average score across eight benchmarks rose from 33.19 to 42.95 (+9.76). Looking ahead, we believe CoworkOS opens a meaningful path toward general cowork-agent intelligence.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CoworkOS，一个面向长程生产力任务的通用 agent 运行框架：模型负责决定动作、委派与验收，运行时负责维护状态与反馈，并以分层工作区与持久语义记忆支撑跨会话续作；在 12 个基准和 6 类真实应用上与前沿 agent 应用比较，并给出自动化后训练案例。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「策略与执行管理分离」、外部持久状态以及模型自行判定「验收/停止」的设计，可为 LVR 中推理状态是否需要外置、长程停止决策与成本核算提供对照视角，但无论视觉任务也无 latent 机制，启发联系需核查。
